findings.description: Unsanctioned AI serving container 'ollama/ollama:latest' running in namespace 'marketing-analytics' on port 11434 without central Model Armor gateway.
Unsanctioned AI serving container 'vllm/vllm-openai:v0.4.2' running in namespace 'data-science-sandbox' on port 8000 without central Model Armor gateway.
Vertex AI Workbench instance 'research-workbench-sandbox-01' executes an unauthenticated startup script that writes privileged access tokens to world-readable disk logs.
Staging bucket 'gs://ml-training-staging-temp' uses legacy Vertex SDK 1.140.0 (<=1.148.0) and lacks Object Retention / Owner locks, exposing neural weights to Pickle-in-the-Middle tampering.
